title: Hampi Utsav (Vijaya Utsav)
summary: Annual state cultural festival with music, dance, processions and light shows among the monuments. Dates are announced each year by the Government of Karnataka, so confirm before planning.

title: Virupaksha Car Festival (Rathotsava)
summary: Chariot festival of the Virupaksha Temple, when the temple car is pulled along Hampi Bazaar. Usually held in March or April; exact dates follow the Hindu calendar.

title: Phala Pooja (Virupaksha–Pampa wedding festival)
summary: Temple festival celebrating the betrothal and marriage of Virupaksha and Pampa, usually around December; exact dates follow the Hindu calendar.
